# The active law levies the tax: its very-high rate is above zero.
te_tax_light_levies_wage = {
	OR = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation }
}
te_tax_light_levies_div = {
	OR = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation }
}

	OR = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation }
}
te_tax_light_levies_head = {
	OR = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation }
}
te_tax_light_levies_cons = {
	OR = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation }
}

# A step's effect on the tax level, read before the step for its tooltip (the step itself
# re-derives the level from the rates). te_tax_light_rg_<key> and te_tax_light_level are
# what the last sync wrote.
#   _up_raises_<key>:   one step up puts the tax on a step above the tax level (the next
#                       index passes the law's rate at that level);
#   _max_raises_<key>:  the very-high rate is above the tax level;
#   _down_lowers_<key>: the tax alone sets the tax level and one step down leaves its step
#                       (index - 1 at or under the rate one level lower);
#   _min_lowers_<key>:  the tax alone sets the tax level and the level is above very low.
te_tax_light_up_raises_wage = {
	has_variable = te_tax_light_level has_variable = te_tax_en_wage has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_wage
	OR = {
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 0 var:te_tax_en_wage >= 2 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 1 var:te_tax_en_wage >= 3 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 2 var:te_tax_en_wage >= 4 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 3 var:te_tax_en_wage >= 5 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 0 var:te_tax_en_wage >= 4 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 1 var:te_tax_en_wage >= 6 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 2 var:te_tax_en_wage >= 8 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 3 var:te_tax_en_wage >= 10 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 0 var:te_tax_en_wage >= 4 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 1 var:te_tax_en_wage >= 5 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 2 var:te_tax_en_wage >= 6 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 3 var:te_tax_en_wage >= 7 }
	}
}

	has_variable = te_tax_light_level has_variable = te_tax_en_wage has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_wage
	te_tax_light_levies_wage = yes
	var:te_tax_light_level < 4

		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 3 var:te_tax_light_rg_land = 3 NOR = { AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_wage var:te_tax_light_rg_wage >= 3 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_div var:te_tax_light_rg_div >= 3 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_head var:te_tax_light_rg_head >= 3 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_cons var:te_tax_light_rg_cons >= 3 } } var:te_tax_en_land <= 29 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 4 var:te_tax_light_rg_land = 4 NOR = { AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_wage var:te_tax_light_rg_wage >= 4 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_div var:te_tax_light_rg_div >= 4 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_head var:te_tax_light_rg_head >= 4 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_cons var:te_tax_light_rg_cons >= 4 } } var:te_tax_en_land <= 35 }

		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 2 var:te_tax_light_rg_land = 2 NOR = { AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_wage var:te_tax_light_rg_wage >= 2 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_div var:te_tax_light_rg_div >= 2 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_head var:te_tax_light_rg_head >= 2 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_cons var:te_tax_light_rg_cons >= 2 } } var:te_tax_en_land <= 12 }

te_tax_light_up_raises_cons = {
	has_variable = te_tax_light_level has_variable = te_tax_en_cons has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_cons
	OR = {
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 0 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 3 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 1 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 4 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 2 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 5 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 3 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 6 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 0 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 3 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 1 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 4 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 2 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 5 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 3 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 6 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 0 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 3 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 1 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 4 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 2 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 5 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 3 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 6 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 0 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 3 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 1 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 4 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 2 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 5 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 3 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 6 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 0 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 3 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 1 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 4 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 2 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 5 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 3 var:te_tax_en_cons >= 6 }
	}

		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 1 var:te_tax_light_rg_cons = 1 NOR = { AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_wage var:te_tax_light_rg_wage >= 1 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_div var:te_tax_light_rg_div >= 1 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_land var:te_tax_light_rg_land >= 1 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_head var:te_tax_light_rg_head >= 1 } } var:te_tax_en_cons <= 4 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 2 var:te_tax_light_rg_cons = 2 NOR = { AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_wage var:te_tax_light_rg_wage >= 2 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_div var:te_tax_light_rg_div >= 2 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_land var:te_tax_light_rg_land >= 2 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_head var:te_tax_light_rg_head >= 2 } } var:te_tax_en_cons <= 5 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 3 var:te_tax_light_rg_cons = 3 NOR = { AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_wage var:te_tax_light_rg_wage >= 3 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_div var:te_tax_light_rg_div >= 3 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_land var:te_tax_light_rg_land >= 3 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_head var:te_tax_light_rg_head >= 3 } } var:te_tax_en_cons <= 6 }
		AND = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation var:te_tax_light_level = 4 var:te_tax_light_rg_cons = 4 NOR = { AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_wage var:te_tax_light_rg_wage >= 4 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_div var:te_tax_light_rg_div >= 4 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_land var:te_tax_light_rg_land >= 4 } AND = { has_variable = te_tax_light_rg_head var:te_tax_light_rg_head >= 4 } } var:te_tax_en_cons <= 7 }
	}
}
te_tax_light_min_lowers_cons = {
